'''Hatchling''' was the callsign of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] Hatchling was on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and reported to Snow Raptor, aka [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Biron]] of the movements of the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]] members.
